@codiesanchez left a finance career managing hundreds of millions in assets to buy laundromats, car washes and roofing companies, then built a 15-million-follower movement teaching others to do the same. Contrarian Thinking now operates across media, investment and advisory, and her new book Own or Be Owned is built around one core idea: know yourself before you follow anyone else's formula. This is her story. Read the full feature online now (link in bio) and in print starting Sept. 22. 📷 : @jakechessum
Some sneak peaks of my new book Own or Be Owned 🤫 Comment OWN let’s get you your copy!

You know you’ve made it when someone is blasting a leaf blower in your face. Thank you to Forbes for a seat with an unreal group on the 2026 Top Creators List. I never set out to be a creator, I just wanted to tell people the truth about ownership and money. The content side was just me telling you what I figured out along the way. Floored that it landed me here.
You believed you could. So you did. Im hosting a free virtual masterclass tomorrow, on business buying. Comment BUY and I’ll send you the link.
My Monday stream of conscious for you ladies and gentlemen.
You don’t need super cars, designers and penthouses… You need land of your own, a true partner and something worth building. Babymoon... Also when did we become adults @chrispetkas
He wouldn't give you the dream if he didn't believe you had what it takes. You have what it takes.
You can call it delusional, but honestly if you don’t continuously strive for more you’re capping your potential. So yeah… I guess I’m delulu.
Let go of doing things perfect, and just move.

You either chose how you feel or you allow your environment to chose for you. PSA: If you chose for yourself you actually get to control how you react and respond to situations (which will benefit you in the long run)

Before you say anything, swipe through the whole thing. In the 15 years I’ve been a part of the business and finance world, one of the biggest things that has stuck with me is proximity always has a price. Let’s get you in the right rooms. COMMENT GROW to join my live upcoming Growth Accelerator Master Class, where I’ll be going over the 5 growth levers needed to scale a business and uncover hidden profits.

If I have a son I’m gonna teach him the difference between right and wrong, and if I have a daughter, I’m gonna teach her how to say no, shoot guns, and break jaws. Sooooo your son better be taught respect. I believe in due process, yet this entire case makes me sad for men and women, teach your sons when a woman is incapacitated to send her home not take advantage. Teach your daughters to protect and love themselves. I hate this war between the sexes, as there is no stronger protector than my husband, my father, my teams that I work with. But what it reminds me is we need to raise strong value driven women. Because the world won’t be strong for them. *also lord help anyone that messes with her with @chrispetkas for a father.
